descripcion: Simulates a real WiFi interface inside the instance using mac80211_hwsim, for apps that do not work without a detected WiFi connection.
queToca: loads the mac80211_hwsim kernel module on the host
moves radio interfaces (phys) from the host's netns to the instance's netns
runs commands inside the container (svc wifi, cmd wifi connect-network) to force the connection

es.descripcion: Simula una interfaz WiFi real dentro de la instancia usando mac80211_hwsim, para apps que no funcionan sin una conexion WiFi detectada.
queToca: carga el modulo de kernel mac80211_hwsim en el host
mueve interfaces de radio (phys) del netns del host al netns de la instancia
ejecuta comandos dentro del contenedor (svc wifi, cmd wifi connect-network) para forzar la conexion
